mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have overcast skies and 44-degree temperatures over Badger Prairie County Park. The moon is in a waning crescent phase, and we expect an overnight low of 33 degrees with no rain predicted.

In city news, the Plan Commission is set to review projects at the Liberty Business Park on December 7th. Additionally, the City of Verona continues to coordinate with AECOM for ongoing engineering services, while the Public Works Department remains busy with routine maintenance of our streets and utilities.

We have a busy schedule ahead. Today features Yoga at Insight Wellness. Looking toward tomorrow, you can catch live music at Bailey's Run or head to the Capitol Square for the Dane County Farmer's Market.
In a noteworthy call from our weekly report, on October 25, officers arrested a 40-year-old local man for O W I after he was discovered asleep behind the wheel at an intersection.
Today's flavor at Culver's is the delicious Chocolate Covered Strawberry. The store is currently open, so stop by before they close at 10:00 PM tonight.
